source: tools/mantis_ant.py build (static decode of record 0 at C2:D080 and its tables, runs of the real game frame on map 260 via tools/boss_fight.py, rips via tools/rip_boss.py)

spawn.map_object_record: map 260 object 0: tile (13, 14), flag 0x10 range 0-15, event word 0x4112
spawn.shared_with: boss id 0x63 (the action routine branches on obj+$42)

time_base.rule: flags 0x1C11: high byte & 3 == 0 -> the boss runs when $56 == 0 (one frame in five)

chooser_model.rule: target = first living active hero with the smallest |dx|+|dy| (C2:3224); dir = 8-direction code (C2:2E50); k = distance class (C2:08BC). k >= 2: walk table by dir. k < 2: rand(2) != 0 -> walk table; else rand(2) == 0 -> idle 00 (D09E), else pose 0D (D0AA). rand(n) = (r * (n + 1)) >> 8 with r one byte of the C2 RNG.

action_model.rule: runs when the action counter $AD reaches 47 at the end of a state (or cuts a mode-1 state). dir 6 (target straight above): no action, the chooser runs instead (a jump up). k >= 4: rand(2) == 0 -> 08 (Gem Missile) else 07 + 10 (swing, homing projectile); k == 3: 13 (effect object type 3); k < 3: claw table by dir.

hurt.note: sound 0x94 (= obj+$1AF of the boss, its hit sound) is requested in the frame the pending damage is applied; 0x24 is the hero swing
